exempt.why: Grounding reads a source's tier and the captures it cites; the word 'coverage' there is a span's coverage of a claim, not the registry's.
The sweep stage reads sources to decide what to check; it states no coverage to a customer.
The heal reads sources to register the page a figure cites; it states no coverage to a customer.
A producer reading its own source row; it states no coverage to a customer.
Operations coverage is facts per region and dimension (region_dimension_coverage), a count of facts; it reads sources only to rate them.
